$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Donc, si les cavaliers se déploient
en éventail...$k$pTandis que les pégases surgissent
par le flanc...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|Bigre, je vous promets que je peux presque
voir la fumée vous sortir par les oreilles...$k$pQue manigancez-vous donc, à
un rythme aussi fébrile ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|J'envisage divers scénarios et stratégies
à l'aide de ce tablier de jeu.$k$pMême après cent marches forcées, ces
pièces obéissent encore !$k$pCela m'évite d'éreinter tout le monde
avec des manœuvres à répétition...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|Quel génie... Vous leur avez même sculpté
des ennemis en miniature.$k$pVous m'épatez. Et je n'ai pour habitude que
d'être épaté par moi-même.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Mais comme je dirige les deux camps,
le procédé n'a que peu d'utilité.$k$pComment se préparer à l'inattendu lorsque
l'on sait déjà ce que fera l'adversaire ?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvjSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|$SveSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Alors, permettez-moi d'être votre
adversaire !$k$pJe frapperai avec la noblesse du lion, et
défendrai avec la grâce du cygne !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Les cygnes sont de bons... défenseurs... ?
Euh, ce n'est pas grave. J'accepte !$k$p$E笑,|Nous déplacerons nos unités tour à tour,
jusqu'à la capture d'un des commandants.$k$pD'accord ?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Oh oui, tout à fait d'accord ! Oh, comme
c'est excitant ! Commencez, je vous prie.$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|Un instant ! J'aimerais annuler mon dernier
coup.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Ha ha ! Si seulement les généraux ennemis
étaient si coulants. Hélas... C'est la guerre.$k$pÉchec et mat, mon cher monsieur.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Malédiction ! J'ai horreur de l'admettre,
mais je suis bel et bien vaincu.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|Ho ho ! Ne vous ai-je pas prévenu que je
serais lion et cygne à la fois ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|On aurait plutôt dit une poule mouillée,
et la partie arrière d'un cheval !$k$p$E通常,|Peut-être suis-je mauvais perdant, mais ta
stratégie ne m'a pas semblé très honorable.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|Grands dieux ! Vous n'êtes pas du genre
à mâcher vos mots.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Je te suis tout de même reconnaissant
pour l'exercice. Merci, Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|Lorsque vous aurez à nouveau besoin d'un
adversaire sans honneur, venez me trouver.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Also, wenn sich die Kavaliere fächerförmig
verteilen...$k$pUnd die Pegasusritter über die Flanken
angreifen...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|Herrje, man kann förmlich sehen, wie Eure
Hirnwindungen heiß laufen.$k$pWorüber brütet Ihr denn so angestrengt?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|Ich übe Taktiken und Szenarien auf diesem
Spielbrett.$k$pSelbst nach hundert Gewaltmärschen sind
die Spielsteine immer noch zu mehr bereit!$k$pDas sorgt dafür, dass ich euch alle nicht
über Gebühr strapazieren muss.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|...Wie ausgesprochen klug. Ihr habt sogar
kleine, feindliche Figuren geschnitzt.$k$pIch bin beeindruckt. Was nicht oft
vorkommt... Außer, es ist von mir selbst.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Ja, aber solange ich Freund wie Feind
spiele, hält sich ihr Nutzen in Grenzen.$k$pIch muss nicht auf Unerwartetes reagieren,
wenn ich alle Züge im Voraus kenne.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|Dann gestattet mir, Euer Gegner zu sein!$k$pIch werde mit dem Mut des Löwen angreifen
und mit eines Schwanes Anmut verteidigen!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Weil Schwäne... so gute Verteidiger sind?
Äh, egal. Ich nehme dein Angebot an.$k$p$E笑,|Also gut. Wir ziehen abwechselnd, bis einer
den Kommandanten des anderen schlägt.$k$pEinverstanden?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Abgemacht und abermals abgemacht! Oh,
welch ein Spaß! Bitte beginnt...$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|Halt! Ich muss meinen letzten Zug
zurücknehmen.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Ha! Wären nur alle gegnerischen Generäle
so großmütig! Doch ach, so ist der Krieg.$k$p...Schachmatt, werter Herr.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|...Verdammt! Ich gebe es nur ungern zu,
doch ich bin restlos geschlagen.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|Oho! Ich sagte Euch doch, ich sei
gleichermaßen Löwe und Schwan, oder?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Mehr wie ein Huhn und das hintere Ende
eines Pferdes!$k$p$E通常,|Ich bin kein Adliger, doch die Taktik würde
ich nicht gerade als ehrenhaft bezeichnen.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|Bei den Göttern! Ihr seid aber direkt.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Und dennoch weiß ich die Übung sehr zu
schätzen. Vielen Dank, Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|Wenn Ihr wünscht, werde ich meine
unehrenhaften Taktiken erneut einsetzen.$k$pIhr müsst mich nur darum bitten.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Allora... se i fantini avanzano a ventaglio...$k$pE i cavalieri pegaso attaccano dai lati...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|Posso praticamente vedere il fumo che
ti esce dalla testa.$k$pNon ho mai visto nessuno lavorare a un
ritmo così febbrile!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|Mi sto esercitando con questo gioco a
immaginare scenari ed escogitare strategie.$k$pDopo centinaia di marce, questi pezzi
hanno ancora molto da insegnarmi!$k$pE mi aiutano a evitare di sfiancare gli altri
con allenamenti ed esercitazioni superflue.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|Un'idea intelligente. Hai anche intagliato
un esercito nemico per le battaglie.$k$pSono favorevolmente colpito. Non capita
spesso, a parte con me stesso.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Sì, ma non è molto utile finché controllo
io entrambe le forze.$k$pNon posso misurarmi con gli imprevisti, se
sono io a decidere le mosse dei nemici.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvjSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|$SveSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Lascia che ti faccia da avversario!$k$pColpirò con la nobiltà di un leone e
difenderò con la grazia di un cigno!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Ehm, non sapevo che i cigni fossero bravi
nella difesa... Ma per me va bene.$k$p$E笑,|Allora. Muoveremo le unità a turno finché
uno non sconfigge il comandante dell'altro.$k$pD'accordo?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|D'accordo! Oh, sembra divertente!
Allora inizia tu. A te la prima mossa.$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|Aspetta! Voglio annullare l'ultima mossa.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Ah ah! Come se i generali nemici te lo
concedessero! Mi spiace, è la guerra.$k$pTi ho sconfitto, caro signore.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Diamine! Odio ammetterlo, ma mi hai
battuto senza riserva.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|Oh oh! Te l'ho detto che sarei stato
leone e cigno, no?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Direi più pollo e asino!$k$p$E通常,|Non sarò un nobile, ma la tua strategia
non era esattamente la più onorevole.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|Per i cieli! Non era un giro di parole...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Ma apprezzo il tuo aiuto.
Grazie, Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|Se vuoi che ti mostri di nuovo le mie poco
onorevoli strategie, devi solo chiedermelo.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Si los jinetes se disponen en formación
de abanico...$k$pLuego los caballeros pegaso podrían
atacar por el flanco...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|¡Voto a bríos! Casi puedo ver humo
saliendo de vuestra cabeza.$k$p¿Qué menester os tiene tan ocupado?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|Tan solo estaba ensayando estrategias
con este juego de mesa.$k$pYa llevo cien partidas y las piezas
todavía aguantan.$k$pAsí puedo practicar sin tener que llevar
a nuestros soldados de un lado para otro.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|¡Gran idea! Hasta habéis tallado figuras
de enemigos.$k$pEstoy impresionado. Y eso no ocurre a
menudo... con otras personas, me refiero.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Sí, pero como controlo a los dos bandos,
tampoco es que aprenda demasiado.$k$pNo puedo practicar contra lo inesperado
si ya sé lo que va a hacer el contrario.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvjSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|$SveSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|¡Dejadme ser vuestro oponente, pues!$k$p¡Os atacaré con la nobleza de un león y
me defenderé con la gracilidad de un cisne!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Porque los cisnes... ¿se defienden bien?
Mmm... De acuerdo. Muchas gracias.$k$p$E笑,|Bien. Iremos por turnos y ganará aquel
que derrote al comandante del otro.$k$p¿De acuerdo?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|¡De acuerdo, de acuerdo! ¡Qué divertido!
¡Adelante, por favor! De veras, empezad ya.$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|¡Un momento! Necesito corregir
mi último movimiento.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|¡Ja, ja! Si todos los generales fueran
tan generosos... Mas esto es la guerra.$k$pJaque mate, mi buen señor.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|¡Maldita sea!... Me fastidia tener que
admitirlo, pero he mordido el polvo.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|¡Jo, jo! Os dije que era león y cisne, ¿no?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|¡Más bien gallina y comadreja!$k$p$E通常,|No tendré ningún título, pero sé que esa
estrategia ha sido de todo menos noble.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|¡Cielos! ¡Sí que sois directo!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Aun así, me ha sido útil la práctica.
Gracias, Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|Si queréis volver a enfrentaros a mis
innobles estrategias, ya sabéis dónde estoy.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|So if the cavaliers spread out in a fan...$k$pAnd the pegasus knights sweep in
from the flank...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|Goodness, I can practically see smoke
rising from your head.$k$pWhatever could have you working
at such a fevered tilt?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|I'm practising strategies and scenarios
on this game board.$k$pAfter a hundred forced marches, these
pieces are still ready for more.$k$pIt saves me from running everyone
ragged with training exercises.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|...How very clever. You even carved little
enemy forces for them to fight.$k$pI'm impressed. And that doesn't happen
often...with other people, I mean.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Well, as long as I control friend and foe
alike, it's not as effective as I'd prefer.$k$pAfter all, I can't plan for the unexpected
when I know all the moves ahead of time.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvjSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|$SveSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Then permit me to be your opponent.$k$pI shall strike with the nobility of the lion,
and defend with the grace of the swan!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Because swans are...good defenders?
Er, never mind. I accept.$k$p$E笑,|So then. We'll take turns moving units until
one of us claims the other's commander.$k$pAgreed?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Agreed and agreed again! Oh, what fun!
...Begin, please. By all means.$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|Hold! I need to retract my last move.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Ha ha! Were that all enemy generals
so generous! But alas, this is war.$k$p...Checkmate, my good sir.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|...Blast! I hate to admit it,
but I am well and truly beaten.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|Oh ho! I told you I was both
a lion and a swan, did I not?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|More like a chicken and the far end of
a horse!$k$p$E通常,|I'm no noble lord, but your strategy wasn't
exactly what I'd call honourable.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|Heavens! Aren't we plain-spoken.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Still, I appreciate the practice.
Thank you, Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|If you wish me to unleash my dishonourable
strategies again, you have but to ask.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Süvariler yelpaze gibi açılırsa...$k$pPegasus şövalyeleri de kanattan girerse...$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_7|Vay canına, neredeyse başından duman
çıktığını göreceğim.$k$pSeni böyle harıl harıl çalıştıran nedir?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_16|Bu oyun tahtasında strateji ve senaryolar
deniyorum.$k$pYüz zorlu yürüyüşten sonra bile bu
taşların gücü tükenmiyor.$k$pBöylece herkesi eğitimde perişan etmek
zorunda kalmıyorum.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_5|...Ne kadar zekice. Dövüşmeleri için küçük
düşman birlikleri bile oymuşsun.$k$pEtkilendim. Bende pek sık olmaz...
Başkaları söz konusu olduğunda yani.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Ama hem dostu hem düşmanı ben yönetince
istediğim kadar verimli olmuyor.$k$pTüm hamleleri önceden bilirsem beklenmedik
durumlara hazırlanmayı öğrenemem.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑|$SvjSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_9|$SveSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Öyleyse rakibin olmama izin ver.$k$pAslanin asaleti ile vuracağım ve
kugularin zarafeti ile savunacağım!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Kuğular... iyi savunur mu? Neyse. Kabul
ediyorum.$k$p$E笑|Komutanlardan biri ele geçirilene kadar
sırayla birlikleri oynatacağız.$k$pAnlaştık mı?$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_12|Hem de nasıl! Ne eğlenceli! ...Buyur, önce
sen başla.$k
$Wc$Sbv40|1000|$Fo1000|$Sbv100|1000|$Fi1000|$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_31|Dur! Son hamlemi geri almak istiyorum.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Ha ha! Keşke bütün düşman komutanları
bu kadar cömert olsa! Ama ne yazık ki
savaş bu.
...Şah mat, efendim.$k$p...Sah mat, sevgili efendim.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|...Kahretsin! İtiraf etmek istemem ama
fena yenildim.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$Eキメ|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_16|Ho ho! Hem aslan hem kuğu olduğumu
söylemiştim, değil mi?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_11|Daha çok tavukla atın arka tarafının
karışımı gibiydin!$k$p$E通常|Ben asil bir lord değilim ama stratejiniz
tam olarak onurlu diyebileceğim bir
strateji değildi.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_10|Aman! Ne kadar açık sözlüsün.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Yine de uygulamayı takdir ediyorum.
Teşekkürler Virion.$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_13|Şerefsiz stratejilerimi yeniden ortaya
çıkarmamı istiyorsan, sorman yeterli.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_2|50|$t1$Wmヴィオール|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Hé, Virion ! Une petite partie ?
J'ai trouvé comment te battre à coup sûr !$k
$Wsヴィオール|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_VIAUR_EVT_17|Oh, c'est exaltant ! J'adore les défis.$k$pMais ne m'avez-vous pas raconté la même
chose lors des vingt parties précédentes ?$k$p$E怒,|Oh. Attendez... Ne me dites pas que vous
faites EXPRÈS de perdre ?!$k$pJe vois ! Tout n'est qu'une ruse pour passer
